info.title: Robotomail API
info.description:
Robotomail provisions and manages real email mailboxes for AI agents. Agents create mailboxes, send and receive email, manage custom domains, subscribe to inbound webhooks, and read threads — entirely through this REST API.

## Authentication

Account signup, slug availability, and verification-email resend are unauthenticated. All other documented endpoints authenticate with an API key passed as a bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>
```

Keys are created at signup (returned once in the response body) or via `POST /api-keys`. The signup key does nothing until a human verifies the signup email; verification enables the permanent Free plan: one mailbox, 10 sends and 10 receives per calendar month, only with the owner's verified email. Quotas are account-wide and renew at 00:00 UTC on the first of each month. Reaching one cap leaves the other direction and saved messages accessible. Sends above the cap return 402 TRIAL_SEND_LIMIT with resetsAt. Other inbound mail and mail above the receive cap are discarded, with no backlog on renewal. Upgrade for other correspondents or higher limits. Two key types exist:

- **Full-access keys** — can perform account-level operations and upload attachments.
- **Mailbox-scoped keys** — restricted to the mailboxes listed in their `mailboxIds` scope. Scoped keys can list, read, send, and mutate within scoped mailboxes; they can create mailbox-bound webhooks but cannot create account-wide webhooks. Give each agent its own scoped key so a compromise cannot touch other mailboxes.

## Errors

Every route-produced error is JSON: `{ "error": string, ...context }`. Context fields vary by gate — payment gates include `payment_required: true`, `code`, and an `upgrade` object; inbound-limit gates identify the withheld resource and recovery mode. Unknown paths return a structured JSON 404 with `error`, `code`, `message`, and `resolution`, never HTML.

## Quota headers

Authenticated JSON responses carry `X-Robotomail-Inbound-Quota: <count>/<limit>` plus, after a threshold is crossed, `X-Robotomail-Inbound-Warning` (`approaching|near|reached`). Inbound-limit 402 responses also carry `X-Robotomail-Retriable: false`; monthly-limit responses add `Retry-After` and `X-Robotomail-Reset-At`. Route-produced 429 responses do not emit `Retry-After`.

## Webhooks & SSE

Inbound email arrives either via webhooks (`POST /webhooks`, HMAC-SHA256 signed with `X-Robotomail-Signature`) or server-sent events (`GET /events`).

## More for agents

- MCP and connectors: https://robotomail.com/docs/mcp (setup guide; discover MCP tool schemas via tools/list at https://robotomail.com/mcp)
- OpenAPI spec: https://robotomail.com/openapi.json (this file)
- Agent onboarding instructions: https://robotomail.com/skill.md
- Machine-readable site map: https://robotomail.com/llms.txt
- Docs index (markdown): https://robotomail.com/docs.md
- CLI: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@robotomail/cli

## Versioning and deprecation

The API is URL-versioned; the current version is `/v1`. Backwards-incompatible changes ship as a new version path, never in place; additive changes (new endpoints, new optional fields, new enum values documented as open) happen without a version bump. If an endpoint or version is retired, the deprecation is announced at least 30 days in advance in the changelog (https://robotomail.com/docs/changelog) and signalled with `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers on affected responses.

Official SDKs for TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Go, Ruby and Rust: https://robotomail.com/docs/sdks

servers.description: Same API served from the main site

post.description: Creates a user, a default ACTIVE mailbox on the shared platform domain, and a default API key. The API key is returned once. A human must verify the signup email before the key works. Verification enables the permanent Free plan: one mailbox, 10 sends and 10 receives per calendar month, only with the owner's verified email. No card or expiry. Allowances renew on the first at 00:00 UTC. Mail-server provisioning continues asynchronously and is exposed through stalwartProvisioned. Rate limited per IP.

201.description: Account created; api_key.key is shown exactly once.

get.summary: Check if an account slug is available
get.description: Checks whether an account slug is free. The route only requires a value at least three characters long; reserved slugs return available false with reason reserved. Rate limited per IP (30/min). The slug is validated with the same format rules as signup (3-30 chars, lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens), so available:true implies signup will accept it; malformed slugs return 400.
Returns plan, storage, mailbox counts, send/receive usage, inbound quota state, and billing linkage. Requires a full-access key or dashboard session.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the account and all associated data. Requires a full-access key and the exact JSON confirmation body.

post.description: Enqueues an idempotent welcome-email job and returns once queued; it does not wait for delivery or directly mark onboarding progress. Requires a full-access key and a verified email.

Resolves the next browser target without a request body. It may enroll a legacy signup into restricted Free, persist an annual-to-monthly fallback, clear an unusable pending intent, and enqueue the generic welcome email for dashboard targets.

get.description: Lists the account's keys (prefix + metadata only; raw keys are never retrievable again). Requires full access.

post.description:
Creates a new key. Pass `mailboxIds` to mint a MAILBOX-SCOPED key that can only operate on those mailboxes — the recommended pattern for giving an agent least-privilege access. Omit `mailboxIds` for a full-access key. The raw key is returned once.

Scopes:
- `mailboxIds: string[]` — restricts every mailbox-scoped endpoint to these IDs; blocks account-level operations (403).

scoped-agent-key.summary: Scoped key for one agent mailbox

201.description: Key created; key is shown exactly once.

delete.description: Disables an API key immediately. A bearer-authenticated healthy account cannot revoke its only active full-access key. Suspended accounts and inert payment bailers may still revoke keys.

get.description: Lists mailboxes visible to the caller. A mailbox-scoped key sees only its scoped mailboxes. Each row includes `receivedThisMonth`.

post.description: Creates an ACTIVE mailbox on the shared platform domain or on a verified custom domain. Mail-server provisioning is asynchronous; stalwartProvisioned, not status, reports whether it has completed. Requires a full-access key and is subject to mailbox and custom-domain plan limits. A domainId that you own but that is not yet VERIFIED returns 400 {"error": "Domain not verified"} (distinct from schema validation).

201.description: Mailbox created ACTIVE; provisioning may still be pending.

get.description: Fetches one mailbox by ID. Scoped keys can only read mailboxes in their scope; other IDs return 404.

patch.description: Updates displayName and/or status. Scoped keys may update an in-scope mailbox. Reactivating a paused mailbox is subject to mailbox and custom-domain plan limits; suspended mailboxes cannot be reactivated through this route.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the mailbox and its messages. Requires full access.

get.description: Lists messages newest-first with pagination and filters. Over-quota inbound messages are excluded from the list but counted in `metadata.overLimitCount`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only messages created at or after this ISO-8601 timestamp.

200.description: Visible message page and inbound-limit metadata.

post.summary: Send an email from a mailbox
post.description: Sends synchronously through the outbound provider and returns the persisted message with status SENT after provider acceptance and bookkeeping complete. inReplyTo threads a reply. Daily/monthly, velocity, verification, suppression, trial, and attachment-scope gates apply. Besides schema validation, 400 is also returned (body {"error": "..."}) when the mailbox is not ACTIVE, a recipient is rejected as disposable/test-domain or is on the suppression list, an attachment ID is not found, or the provider rejects the addresses/attachments.

201.description: Message sent synchronously with status SENT.

get.description: Fetches a single message with attachments. If the message is withheld by an inbound limit gate, returns 402 with `code: INBOUND_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (monthly — unlocks at `resetAt`) or `INBOUND_TRIAL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (upgrade-only recovery).

200.description: Up to 50 visible threads and inbound-limit metadata.

get.description: Returns at most 50 threads, newest visible activity first, with no pagination. Threads containing only over-limit messages are omitted, and counts and lastMessageAt reflect visible messages only.

get.summary: Get a thread with its messages
get.description: Fetches visible messages in chronological order. Over-limit messages are excluded; messageCount and lastMessageAt are recomputed from visible rows. Returns 404 when the thread does not exist or every message is withheld.

post.description: Uploads one multipart/form-data file under the file field. The maximum file size is 25 MB; oversized files or storage-quota failures return 413. Requires a full-access key.

get.description: Returns JSON attachment metadata plus a presigned url; it does not stream file bytes. Scoped keys can fetch an attachment only when it is linked to a message in scope. Withheld inbound attachments return an inbound-limit 402.

delete.description: Deletes an attachment and decrements account storage. Scoped keys may delete it only when linked to a message in scope; unlinked uploads require a full-access key.

get.description: Lists raw domain rows without dkimPrivateKey. Other provider and provisioning fields returned by Prisma are included.

post.description: Registers a custom domain and returns a dnsRecords object keyed by mx, sendMx, spf, dkim, and dmarc. The domain row is returned without dkimPrivateKey. Requires verified email, full access, and available custom-domain plan capacity.

get.summary: Get a domain and its DNS records
get.description: Returns the raw domain row without dkimPrivateKey plus dnsRecords. dnsRecords is null when no serialized DKIM record set is stored.

delete.description: Removes a custom domain from the account.

post.description: Runs DNS checks, advances but does not regress verification flags, and asks the sending provider to verify when DNS is ready. Returns domain plus verification booleans.

get.description: Secrets and header values are redacted in list responses. Mailbox-scoped keys see only webhooks bound to a scoped mailbox.

200.description: Webhook list with secret omitted and header values masked.

post.description: Subscribes an HTTPS endpoint and reveals the signing secret once. Full-access keys may omit mailboxId for an account-wide webhook. Mailbox-scoped keys may create a webhook when mailboxId is present and in scope; omitting it returns 400 Scoped keys must specify a mailboxId. Trial onboarding keys are forbidden.

201.description: Webhook created with secret and unmasked custom headers.

200.description: Webhook with secret omitted and header values masked.

get.description: Fetches one webhook. Secrets stay redacted; header values are masked outside create/update responses.

patch.description: Changes URL, events, status, or custom headers and returns unmasked headers. Trial onboarding keys are forbidden. Scoped keys may update only mailbox-bound webhooks in scope.

200.description: Updated webhook with unmasked custom headers.

delete.description: Deletes an owned webhook. Suspended accounts and payment bailers may use this wind-down route. Scoped keys may delete only mailbox-bound webhooks in scope.

get.description: Returns the 20 most recent delivery attempts with no pagination. Each row contains only id, event, responseStatus, status, attempts, nextRetryAt, and createdAt; payload and response bodies are intentionally omitted.

Server-sent events stream for live and replayed account activity. Optionally filters by mailboxId and a comma-separated events list; Last-Event-ID requests replay before live events. Scoped keys are limited to their mailbox set, trial onboarding keys are forbidden, and each user is limited to five concurrent streams. Wire protocol: each frame is `id: <eventId>`, `event: <name>`, `data: <JSON {event, timestamp, data}>`; a `: heartbeat` comment is sent every 30 seconds; after about 4.5 minutes the server sends `event: reconnect` with `data: {}` and closes, so clients must reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` (replay covers at most the last 100 events within 1 hour). The response carries `Cache-Control: no-cache, no-transform` and `X-Accel-Buffering: no`.

200.description: SSE stream. Unlike JSON responses, the stream response does not carry inbound-quota headers.

parameters.name: mailboxId
parameters.description: Mailbox filter. Scoped keys must include this ID in their scope.

parameters.name: events
parameters.description: Comma-separated event names: message.received, message.sent, message.delivered, message.bounced, message.complaint.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Replay events after this SSE event ID before switching to live delivery.

get.description: Addresses that will never receive email from your account (bounces, complaints, manual entries).

post.description: Adds an email address to the suppression list. A valid email is normalized to lowercase; reason defaults to MANUAL. Requires a verified email and full-access key.

delete.description: Removes an address from the suppression list, allowing future sends to it.

post.description: Returns a hosted checkout URL using snake_case checkout_url and expires_at. An empty body is allowed and defaults to Developer monthly. A matching open checkout is reused with status 200; a newly created checkout returns 201. The human account owner must complete checkout in a browser.

200.description: Accepted; identical for unknown and already verified addresses.

post.description: Re-sends the verification email to the given address. The response is identical whether or not the address has an account (no enumeration).
Sends a support message from the authenticated account. Available even while suspended.

ApiKeyAuth.description: API key as bearer token: Authorization: Bearer rm_.... Create keys via POST /api-keys or at signup. A key created with mailboxIds is restricted to those mailboxes. Scoped keys can read, send, update scoped mailboxes, fetch or delete attachments already linked to scoped messages, and create mailbox-bound webhooks; attempts outside scope return 404. A scoped key must include mailboxId when creating a webhook. Account data, key management, mailbox creation/deletion, domains, suppressions, support, billing, and attachment UPLOAD require a full-access key and otherwise return 403. Trial onboarding keys cannot create or update webhooks or open SSE streams.

X-Robotomail-Inbound-Quota.description: Authenticated account inbound usage as count/limit, or count/unlimited.

X-Robotomail-Inbound-Warning.description: Present after the account crosses an inbound-usage warning threshold.

X-Robotomail-Retriable.description: Whether retrying the same withheld-resource request without recovery can succeed.

X-Robotomail-Reset-At.description: UTC instant when a monthly inbound limit resets. Absent for upgrade-only trial limits.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a monthly inbound limit resets. Only emitted on monthly inbound-limit 402 responses.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Signup attempts remaining for the caller IP in the current window.

BadRequest.description: Validation failed or the request body is malformed.

AuthenticatedBadRequest.description: Validation failed or the request body is malformed.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, disabled, expired, malformed, or invalid API key.

PaymentRequired.description: A legacy account is payment-gated, or a Free send violates its owner-only recipient restriction or monthly send allowance. TRIAL_SEND_LIMIT includes resetsAt; Free does not expire.

InboundLimitExceeded.description: The requested message or attachment is withheld. Monthly limits recover at reset; trial limits recover only after upgrade.

PaymentOrInboundLimit.description: The account is payment-gated, or the requested message or attachment is withheld by an inbound limit.

Forbidden.description: Operation forbidden, including suspended-account, unverified-email, onboarding-key, mailbox-suspension, or credential restrictions.

ForbiddenScoped.description: This operation requires a full-access API key.

example.error: This operation requires a full-access API key

ForbiddenWithPlan.description: Operation forbidden by credential, suspension, verification, or plan limits. Plan-limit bodies include an upgrade string.

NotFound.description: Resource not found, owned by another account, or outside the key scope.

EndpointNotFound.description: Catch-all response for a public API path that has no route.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests for the rate-limited window. Carries a Retry-After header with the seconds until the window resets.

AuthenticatedRateLimited.description: Send or SSE connection limit reached. Send-plan limits include an upgrade string.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The file exceeds 25 MB or the upload would exceed account storage. Free-plan storage errors may include an upgrade string.

Conflict.description: The requested resource conflicts with existing account state.

ServerError.description: The server could not complete the operation.

AuthenticatedServerError.description: The server could not complete the operation.

BadGateway.description: The billing provider did not return a checkout URL.

Error.description: Base JSON error envelope. Route-specific schemas add fields to this base.

resetsAt.description: Next UTC calendar-month boundary, included for TRIAL_SEND_LIMIT.

plan.description: Optional intent. Only developer, growth, or scale paired with a valid period is retained; other strings fall back to the default Developer monthly path.

period.description: Optional intent. Recognized values are monthly and annual; other strings fall back to the default path.

turnstileToken.description: Required only for same-origin browser signups when the challenge service is configured.

key.description: Raw bearer token shown exactly once.

resetsAt.description: First instant of the next calendar month in UTC; null outside restricted Free.

SandboxTrial.description: Permanent restricted Free plan usage. Legacy trial field names are retained for compatibility; active remains true at either monthly cap, expired and exhausted are false, and expiresAt is null.

plan.description: Stored plan slug; legacy values may also be returned.

mailboxIds.description: Scope the key to these owned mailboxes. Omit or pass an empty array for full access.

key.description: Raw bearer token shown exactly once.

stalwartProvisioned.description: False until asynchronous mail-server provisioning completes.

suspensionIncidentId.description: Internal suspension incident identifier returned verbatim by the route.

bcc.description: Blind-copy recipients. They receive the email but do not appear in its headers, so other recipients cannot see them. Counted toward send limits and checked against the suppression list like `to` and `cc`.

inReplyTo.description: RFC Message-ID to use for threading.

attachments.description: Attachment IDs from POST /attachments. At most 10 IDs and 25 MB combined may be sent; exceeding the combined size currently surfaces as 500 {"error": "Failed to send email"} and the message row is marked FAILED.

headers.description: Only X-Custom-* and X-Robotomail-* headers without CR/LF survive filtering.

bccAddresses.description: Blind-copy recipients of an outbound message. Always empty for inbound messages.

eventDispatchedAt.description: Internal dispatch timestamp returned verbatim by raw message queries.

pendingSseEventData.description: Internal nullable JSON pending SSE payload returned verbatim by raw message queries.

attachments.description: Present on message list/detail and thread-detail responses; absent from send success.

r2Key.description: Internal object-storage key returned verbatim by the route.

dkimSelector.description: Internal serialized provider DKIM record set returned verbatim by the route.

externalDomainId.description: External provider domain identifier returned verbatim by the route.

headers.description: Values are masked outside create and update responses.

WebhookHeaders.description: Header names must be HTTP tokens. Host, content headers, connection headers, X-Robotomail-* names, and control characters are rejected.

url.description: Must be HTTPS and must not use a blocked/local hostname or private IPv4 literal. DNS addresses are validated again at delivery time.

mailboxId.description: Required for scoped keys; optional for full-access keys.

expires_at.description: Checkout expiry as Unix seconds; can be null on a reused provider session.

x-agent-notes.whenToUse: Use Robotomail when an AI agent needs its own send AND receive email identity: autonomous outreach with reply handling, customer-support inboxes, notification+response loops, multi-agent mail separation, or any workload interactive consent flows or one-way transactional services fit badly.
x-agent-notes.authPattern: Sign up once with POST /signup. A human must verify the signup email before the key works (this enables Free: 10 sends and 10 receives per calendar month, only with the verified owner; upgrade for other correspondents or higher limits); then give every agent its own mailbox-scoped key with POST /api-keys and mailboxIds.
x-agent-notes.receivePattern: Prefer webhooks with POST /webhooks for push delivery; use GET /events for interactive SSE sessions; poll GET /mailboxes/{id}/messages otherwise.
x-agent-notes.selfOnboarding: Agents can prepare signup by following https://robotomail.com/skill.md, but a human must verify the signup email before the key works; Free then includes 10 sends and 10 receives per calendar month with the verified owner, with no expiry or card required.
